Closing without merging. objectui no longer has its own release lane: since objectstack#25745 (merged into objectstack `main`), every `@object-ui/*` package is released from objectstack's root changesets lane, in one fixed version group with `@objectstack/*`. The changesets this PR would have consumed now sit under `ui/.changeset/` in objectstack and move to the root `.changeset/` with objectstack#25831; the first joint release is 18.2.0 (objectstack#25753). This repository's code now lives in objectstack `ui/` and the repository is being archived (objectstack#25854).

Closed 2026-10-26T01:43Z.
